As a Data Scientist Sr Associate on the Consumer and Business Intelligence team, you'll join a new organization that works together to monitor, coordinate, and develop a shared internal and external view of the financial well-being of consumers and businesses through internal and third-party data. As the nation's largest bank, [Company name masked] is uniquely positioned to inform public perspective on the direction of the economy. During a time of unprecedented macroeconomic uncertainty, identifying emerging trends and economic relationships is of heightened importance.
cond_0531.responsibilities:
Recognize and share meaningful trends and patterns in data as they relate to consumer and business health
Collaborate with economists, econometricians, and data scientists to explore emerging trends in income, spend, savings, and credit
Work with the team to identify and validate data sources and quality
Clearly, carefully, and quickly communicate discoveries with solid data support
Contribute to critical thinking and support a team environment that values attention to detail and results
Help develop presentations to summarize and communicate key messages to senior management, sponsors, and colleagues
Contribute to the continuous learning mindset of the organization by sharing new ideas and perspectives that broaden the group's thinking

4+ Years of experience in a business strategy and analytics role and a BS degree in a related field
Substantial experience with SQL (query/procedure writing)

Clear and succinct written and verbal communication — able to frame and present messages for different audiences
Critical and analytical thinking
Strong Microsoft Excel skills
Ability to manage shifting priorities and projects
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in a relevant field
Experience in Mortgage Banking or Financial Services
Ability to maintain detail focus while retaining big-picture perspective
Excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively with a variety of individuals, departments, and organizations
